newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Cenbank sells dollar-indexed Treasury notes.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Cenbank sells dollar-indexed Treasury notes.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank sold 550 million of dollar-indexed National Treasury Notes (NTN-D) paying annual yields of 11.54 percent, dealers said.
Traders said the Central Bank sold the securities to offer hedge instruments to the market and fight speculation over a possible speed-up in the real-dollar mini-band devaluations.
On Friday, the Central Bank surprised the market lowering the real-dollar mini-band by 0.14 percent to between 1.0415 and 1.0465 reais per greenback.
The NTN-Ds have a maturity period of 24 months and are due in June 1, 1997. The securities were part of the Central Bank's portfolio.
